description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
Changed
- if this PC's language isn't English, the right-click menu in the app's text boxes is now in English too, like the rest of the app.
Fixed
- if your journal stops accepting this PC while a file is importing, the app now always notices and stops, and your files wait on this PC. before, it could miss it and keep trying.
